RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel is not proof of discrimination on its own, but it can reflect systemic underrepresentation and increase the risk of affinity bias, particularly when candidate profiles differ in technical depth versus managerial background. However, senior leadership hiring frequently prioritizes broader administrative scope and interview performance over specialist credentials like a PhD. 

Rather than immediately raising the panel's gender composition, first follow up professionally on your requested written feedback. Review whether the stated criteria align with the advertised job requirements. If the explanation appears arbitrary or inconsistent, consult a confidential HR advisor, union representative, or employment lawyer to evaluate whether a formal grievance regarding procedural fairness or bias is warranted.
